flashcard_questions.q: What does the word Church mean beyond the building?
flashcard_questions.a: The community of believers who follow Jesus’s teachings.

flashcard_questions.q: Which parable teaches that a neighbour is anyone in need?
flashcard_questions.a: The Parable of the Good Samaritan.

flashcard_questions.q: Which charity supports around 1,700 food bank centres across the UK?
How long is a food bank emergency parcel meant to last?
Which verse do Christians quote to support food bank work?
flashcard_questions.a: Matthew 25:35 — “For I was hungry and you gave me something to eat.”

flashcard_questions.q: When do street pastors usually patrol town and city centres?
flashcard_questions.a: At night on Friday and Saturday evenings.

flashcard_questions.q: Why do street pastors not try to convert the people they help?
flashcard_questions.a: They demonstrate Christian love through practical care instead of preaching.
Sharing the good news of Jesus Christ with non-believers.
The Church’s calling to carry out God’s work in the world.

flashcard_questions.q: What did Jesus command his followers to do in Matthew 28:19?
flashcard_questions.a: “Go and make disciples of all nations, baptising them.”

flashcard_questions.q: Which archbishop chaired South Africa’s Truth and Reconciliation Commission?
Which verse warned Christians that they would face persecution?
flashcard_questions.a: John 15:20 — “If they persecuted me, they will persecute you also.”

flashcard_questions.q: Which month is Christian Aid Week held in each year?
What is distinctive about the way Tearfund works?
flashcard_questions.a: It partners with local church networks to serve their own communities.

notes: 15 cards: 4 term→definition (Church, evangelism, mission, CAFOD), 3 belief→source (Good Samaritan, Matthew 25:35, John 15:20, Matthew 28:19), 4 organisation facts (Trussell Trust, parcel length, Christian Aid Week, Tearfund), 2 practice→meaning (street pastors), 1 person (Desmond Tutu).
